steps.say: Draw your own analysis straight on the chart. | Drawings are saved to your account, on that asset, and show on every candle size.
Press the pencil at the top right of the chart to open the drawing tools.
A trend line: drag from one point to another. | Here, joining two swing points.
A horizontal line marks a price level right across the chart, with its price on the right.
Fibonacci retracement: drag from a swing low to a swing high. | The golden pocket, between sixty-one point eight and sixty-five percent, is shaded.
Measure: drag between two points to see the percent change and the number of candles.
The long or short position: drag from your entry to your stop, then tap your target. | It shows the reward against the risk.
Add a text note anywhere, then press Enter.
Pick a colour and a line width before you draw. | Undo takes back the last change, and the eye hides your drawings without deleting them.
The share button sends the chart, with your drawings, to your communities. | They open it on the same asset, with your drawings on it.
And the bin removes every drawing on this asset. | Press it twice, so you can't do it by accident.
